## International Football — Daily WC2026 Alerts

Sends WhatsApp notifications via Twilio to 5 recipients.

**Two pipelines run daily:**
- **Morning (7am CR):** Upcoming match preview with kickoff times
- **Night (11pm CR):** Final results with scorers

**Filters:** WC2026 qualifying nations only · Leagues 1 (World Cup) & 10 (Friendlies) · No youth teams

**Timezone note:** Fetches both today + next UTC day to cover the CR evening window (6pm–midnight CR = next UTC day).

## Morning Pipeline — 7am CR
Fetches fixtures scheduled for today (CR timezone).
Fetches next UTC day to cover CR evening matches.
Filters → formats preview message → sends to all recipients.

## Night Pipeline — 11pm CR
Fetches completed fixtures for today (CR timezone).
Fetches next UTC day for late CR matches.
Filters → formats results with scorers + minutes → chunks at 1500 chars → sends to all recipients.
